subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Agile
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sluggish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"agile"** means someone who is **quick and light** in movement or thought; someone who is **nimble and active.** (चुस्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The gymnast was incredibly** agile**, performing flips and twists with ease.
 
 
 
• **"Sluggish"** refers to someone or something that is **slow-moving or lacking energy; the opposite of being agile. **(सुस्त)
 
 
• **Example:** After the heavy meal, I felt sluggish and didn't want to move.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'agile'** is **'sluggish'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Active** (सक्रिय): Engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits.

 
 
• **Example:** She is very **active** and participates in various sports.
 
 
 
• **Energetic** (ऊर्जावान): Showing or involving great activity or vitality.
 
 
• **Example:** The kids were **energetic**, running around the playground all day.
 
 
 
• **Apathetic** (उदासीन): Showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern.
 
 
• **Example:** He was **apathetic** towards the charity event and didn't want to participate.
